scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/kelola', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('dist/kelola.html')) fs.copyFileSync('dist/kelola.html', 'dist/kelola/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html'); fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f => (f.startsWith('kelola-') || f === 'profil.js') && f.endsWith('.js')).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f));"
